messages:
sam_acct_mgr: Heads up 0/ Vendor: MediCore is disputing their Sep private deployment invoice. They say platform fee true-up includes a support-tier surcharge that wasn't in their amendment. Procurement put payment on hold.
billing-bot: Invoice #MC-2026-09 generated 2026-09-03 08:30 UTC. platform_fee_total: $32,950; support_tier: enterprise; surcharge_line: Support Migration Surcharge $6,200.
paul_finance: Filing FIN-5880. Sam, did their amendment AM-412 explicitly include a surcharge? Last renewal email didn't mention an extra migration surcharge.
sam_acct_mgr: No, AM-412 only lists upgrade to enterprise effective 2026-09-01 with standard platform fee. Procurement says surcharge isn't in contract.
rachel_billing: Pulling billing events for resource mc-vpc-21 for Sep window. Query: `SELECT id, ts, amount, note FROM billing_events WHERE resource='mc-vpc-21' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30';`
vik_engops: Found event bf-15077: monthly_platform $26,750 (2026-09-01), bf-15078: support_migration_surcharge $6,200 (2026-09-01 00:07) with metadata origin=oncall-migration. Looks like ops-created surcharge entry.
paul_finance: If surcharge was manually added by ops we need clear approval trail. Finance won't post extra AR without signed amendment. Approve a provisional credit to keep the deal moving?
sam_acct_mgr: Customer urgently wants renewal to close. Can we issue a provisional credit equal to the surcharge while we confirm authorization?
rachel_billing: I recommend provisional_credit_amount: $6,200 pending confirmation. We'll mark invoice disputed and create provisional credit memo CM-MC-2026-09-P.
paul_finance: Finance approves provisional credit up to $6,500 for customer satisfaction. GL: CU-CR-MIG. Post provisional only; final posting after contract/legal sign-off.
vik_engops: Root cause: migration team ran an internal migration playbook that auto-applies a "support migration surcharge" line for emergency-assisted migrations; the playbook toggled flag `auto_bill=true` by default. That shouldn't happen for sales-approved migrations. PR to require `billing_approval=true` for surcharge creation pushed (PR #5012). Ticket ENG-BILL-276 opened.
sam_acct_mgr: I'll notify customer: "We've placed a provisional credit of $6,200 while we validate the migration surcharge authorization. We'll confirm final numbers within 48 hours and will not delay your renewal." Approve message?
paul_finance: Approve. Include FIN-5880 and CM reference once created.
rachel_billing: Created provisional credit memo CM-MC-2026-09-P $6,200 and attached to invoice MC-2026-09; invoice flagged disputed.
vik_engops: Backfill/cleanup: we will void the unauthorized bf-15078 if no approved change order exists. Running backfill job backfill-mc-301; ETA ~3 hrs.
vik_engops: Backfill complete 0 removed bf-15078, delta -$6,200. ENG-BILL-276 -> resolved.
rachel_billing: Posting final credit memo CM-MC-2026-09-1 for $6,200 and attaching to MC-2026-09. Invoice status updated to adjusted.
paul_finance: Finance will post GL CU-CR-MIG $6,200 upon CM processing and close FIN-5880 once ledger clears. Also request ops add audit log of approval for any future surcharge.
sam_acct_mgr: Customer replied: "Thanks 1 procurement approved renewal once credit applied. Appreciate fast handling." Closing loop on account side.
paul_finance: Postmortem: (1) change migration playbook to default `auto_bill=false` (2) require billing approval audit trail on surcharge events (3) nightly audit to surface unexpected surcharge events. Owners: vik_engops, paul_finance. FIN-5880: resolved.
